title: Bradley Chubb fined for taunting Alaric Jackson before Jackson punched him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bradley Chubb fined for taunting Alaric Jackson before Jackson punched him
sources.description: Bills linebacker Bradley Chubb did not retaliate physically after Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson punched him in the aftermath of Buffalo's Week 5 win in Los Angeles, but he did get disciplined by the league for his part in the altercation.
